question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words 
  FROM word_list 
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL AND words != ''
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT words, 
         LENGTH(words) AS len
  FROM words
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND words LIKE 'r%'
),
with_sig AS (
  SELECT words, len, 
         STRING_AGG(c, '' ORDER BY c) AS signature
  FROM filtered, UNNEST(SPLIT(words, '')) AS t(c)
  GROUP BY words, len
),
sig_counts AS (
  SELECT signature, COUNT(*) AS anagram_count
  FROM with_sig
  GROUP BY signature
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT ws.words, sc.anagram_count
FROM with_sig ws
JOIN sig_counts sc ON ws.signature = sc.signature
ORDER BY ws.words
LIMIT 10

  SELECT DISTINCT words 
  FROM word_list 
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL AND words != ''
),

FROM filtered
WHERE anagram_count >= 2
ORDER BY words
